claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a Toyota emblem but no Prado badging, part number, or model-year compatibility.
Photo 0 shows two car headlights with projector-style rings, not a taillight.
The report states whether headlight bulbs are included or functional is not shown.
The photo report does not show location and cannot establish where the seller is.

risks.proof: A clip of both headlights powered on, or a photo showing bulbs and sockets installed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as without bulbs and not working.

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or damage in the plastic housing
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rear housing interior and grille slats, or a clip showing the housing flexed to reveal cracks.

risks.risk: Wrong vehicle model or year fitment, not actually for a Prado
risks.proof: A photo of the part number or Toyota label, or a shot of mounting points compared to a Prado.

risks.risk: Broken or missing mounting clips and tabs
risks.proof: A close-up video of every mounting tab and clip on both the grille and headlights.
risks.if_unproven: priced as clips broken or missing.

proof_requests: Video of the headlights switched on
Close-up photos of the rear housings and all mounting tabs
Photo of any part number or Toyota label on the grille and headlights
Video showing the item in GRA Ikeja or a verifiable local landmark
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a used Toyota grille and headlights, so a worst-case price is possible even though the seller's Prado, working-condition, and location claims are unproven.
